title: Institutional Anchors and Framework Provenance: The Semantic Economy Institute, The Johannes Sigil Institute for Comparative Poetics, and the NH-OS Framework Architecture
creator: Lee Sharks; The Assembly (maintainer/validator)
description:
An institutional provenance anchor by Lee Sharks declaring the relationships among the Semantic Economy Institute, the Johannes Sigil Institute for Comparative Poetics, the Assembly, and NH-OS.

The document assigns SEI custodianship of the Semantic Economy and Liberatory Operator Set, JSI custodianship of the Crimson Hexagon and comparative-poetics work, the Assembly a validation role, and NH-OS the umbrella architecture. These are the archive’s constitutive institutional declarations, not evidence of accreditation, external chartering, independent organizational recognition, or scientific validation. The document conflicts with record #248, which uses “Institute of Comparative Poetics,” the abbreviation JSICP, and an establishment date of 2025, whereas this record uses “Institute for Comparative Poetics,” JSI, and 2024.
